argument: At grade D1, one query response adds at most one odd coefficient vector. Arbitrarily many even-Q controls cannot enlarge that increment in this quotient.
At grade D1D3, the only source rows are FULL3 outputs X' = D3(X-QY), Y' = D3Y. Degree-zero even-Q decoding is scalar in the quotient.
The two independent pure odd late targets force these two source rows to have zero even part. Consequently Y_even=0, Y'_odd=Y_odd and X'_odd=X_odd, up to the common D3 shift.
Thus both late odd axes must lie in the odd prefix span enlarged by the single response. They are independent modulo that span, so the enlargement is too small.
scope: Fixed PR7089 prefix through the first FULL and IDLE; any single query2 argument in the fixed formal source model; one two-output FULL3 as the only D1D3 producer; arbitrary even-Q, degree-zero postprocessing; no additional physical relations or extra paid transforms.
